rationale.consistency: Uses slices helpers like surrounding code, but variadic optional params on unexported funcs, a get-prefixed helper and a needless nil-map check are un-idiomatic for this package.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles multiple order lines, invalid directive/positional errors without leaking, nil options and plugin-registered directives; empty-order fallback is over-defensive but harmless.
rationale.scope: Core fix is on target; copying the whole options map and rewriting RegisterDirectiveOrder go somewhat beyond the ask, and the duplicated standardDir panic is dead code.
rationale.readability: Logic is easy to follow, but the options copy that silently drops 'order' has no explanatory comment and the variadic plumbing obscures what buildSubroute/sortRoutes actually need.
rationale.robustness: No global mutation during adaptation, defaults cloned, per-call options copy makes shared-map concurrency safe; only init-time panics remain.
rationale.maintainability: Order fallback is duplicated in getDirectiveOrder and sortRoutes; variadic options means a future caller that forgets to pass them silently reverts to global order, reintroducing the bug class.
